# Two app slots: # running firmware lives. That is the whole reason this file exists: the
# default single-"factory" layout has nowhere to put a second image
# update that overwrites the only copy has no way back if it goes wrong.
# 1.5MB a slot against an 0.8MB image. The headroom is deliberate -- a slot
# that fits today's build exactly is one feature away from being the reason a
# otadata records which slot to boot and whether the last one confirmed
# itself; without it the bootloader has no way to roll anything back.
